description: Source code for the GitExtensionService class, providing methods to interact with Git repositories, gather changes, generate commit context, and handle diffs within a VSCode extension environment.

classes.name: GitExtensionService
classes.description: Main class providing Git repository interaction functionalities such as gathering changes, generating commit context, and diffing files.

methods.name: gatherChanges
methods.description: Collects information about staged or unstaged changes in the repository.

methods.name: spawnGitWithArgs
methods.description: Executes a Git command with specified arguments and returns the output.

methods.name: getDiffForChanges
methods.description: Generates diffs for a list of changes, optionally reporting progress.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of files based on staging options.

methods.name: getGitDiff
methods.description: Gets the diff for a specific file, handling binary and untracked files.

methods.name: getCurrentBranch
methods.description: Returns the current Git branch name.

methods.name: getCommitContext
methods.description: Generates context information for commit messages, including diffs, change summaries, and repository info.

methods.name: getChangeStatusFromCode
methods.description: Converts Git status code to a GitStatus type.

methods.name: getReadableStatus
methods.description: Converts Git status code to human-readable text.

methods.name: shouldIncludeFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be included based on ignore rules and lock file exclusion.

methods.name: reportProgress
methods.description: Reports progress of operations via callback.

methods.name: isBinaryFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is binary based on Git numstat output.

methods.name: isUntrackedFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is untracked in Git.

methods.name: buildNumstatArgs
methods.description: Builds arguments for Git numstat command.

methods.name: buildDiffArgs
methods.description: Builds arguments for Git diff command.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, disposing of ignore controller.
